intake.description: The claimant's car was stolen from outside their building in Salt Lake, Kolkata, between the night of October 18, 2026, and the morning of October 19, 2026. An FIR was registered with the police on October 23, 2026.
intake.severity_reason: Severity is high because the claim involves theft of a vehicle.

citations.quote: We pay for the loss of the insured vehicle, or of parts fitted to it, caused by theft, subject to MOTOR-CON-5.2.
A theft claim is payable only if the theft was reported to the law-enforcement authority within 48 hours of the policyholder discovering it.

coverage.reasoning: The claimant discovered the theft of their vehicle on the morning of October 19, 2026, but did not report it to the police and register an FIR until October 23, 2026, which is beyond the 48-hour limit. Under MOTOR-COV-2.2 and MOTOR-CON-5.2, theft claims are payable only if reported to law enforcement within 48 hours of discovery. Therefore, the claim is not covered due to late reporting to the authorities.
